sourceChecks.text: Joshua said, “By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.

When all the kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, who were by the sea, heard how the LORD had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over, their heart melted, and there was no more spirit in them, because of the children of Israel.
The manna ceased on the next day, after they had eaten of the produce of the land. The children of Israel didn’t have manna any more, but they ate of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,
They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “The LORD commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock.”

The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.

The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”

Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.
I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac.

identityCheckJa: 候補用例は「カナンの地」またはカナン人を指し、個人のカナンを示す用例は確認できないため、book-local collectiveとして扱う。
spoilerCheckJa: 人物profileに採用できる初出はなく、passagesとsourceIdsは空。説明は語の本文上の用法を述べるにとどめる。

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: 英語版「Canaan (son of Ham)」は創世記の人物を指し、JOS5:12等の土地名・カナン人を一人の人物として扱う根拠にはならないため不採用。日本語版の人物候補に適合する記事は検索で確認できなかった。

remainingUncertaintyJa: 地名だけの用例は場所プロフィールに適する可能性がある。人名としての個人同定はしない。
articleReadEvidenceJa: 英語記事「Canaan (son of Ham)」が創世記の個人を扱うことを確認。ヨシュア記のカナンの土地名・住民集団の用例とは一致しないため、人物記事としてリンクしない。

authorRepairs.reasonJa: ヨシュア記5:1の「カナン人の王たち」だけを集団用例として保持。残る候補節は「カナンの地」という地名用法なので人物カードから除外し、place側のカナン候補に任せる。
独立primary reviewが発見したJOS 3:10の初出「カナン人」を集団用例に追加し、knownByを3:10へ修正。JOS 5:1も集団用例として維持。土地名は別の場所候補へ分離。
JOS 3:10時点の常時表示から5:1を含む後続情報を除き、5:1の言及をゲートfactに分離。
